description:
-= Washroom =-
You're now in the washroom. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.



You need an unblocked exit? You should try going south.

There is a fondue on the floor.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, make an effort to venture south. With that over with, retrieve the textbook from the floor of the recreation zone. Alright, thanks!
